Sam: latewind priming handshake — quick async check. Did a slotting tweak + KV prefetch cooldown (80ms) on canary. Observed p95 for short sequences drop ~45ms. Rolling canary across 3 shards now. PR 3421 needs one more reviewer. Blocker: saw an OOM on shard-7 when sequence_len=2048, happened twice during heavy microburst.
Olivia: nice numbers. Can you paste the exact repro command + the OOM stack snippet? I can try to repro locally on my dev rig.
Sam: repro command: `./run_infer --model rdx2-small --seq 2048 --batch 4 --spawn-slot 7 --prefetch-cooldown 80`
Sam: OOM tail: ```
2026-02-18T14:07:53Z runtime ERROR: cuda: out of memory on allocation 3.2GiB
stack: runtime/kernel/batcher.cpp:412 `allocate_slot`
kv_cache: slot-7 mem 28.3GiB -> attempted +3.2GiB
```
Sam: when it OOMed, we had two concurrent large prompts + 12 small ones. Might be slot over-commit under burst.
Mike: I'll take PR 3421 review today. If it's a quick safety patch we can merge and rollback the slot change if OOM recurs.
Rachel: FYI I ran a microbench on the new batcher heuristics at 95% contention; throughput dipped ~8% under mixed chat loads, latency tail was fine though. Opened issue #1284 with graphs.
Olivia: thanks — can you include the microbench config in that issue? Specifically curious about `max_batch_delay` and `slot_reclaim_ms`.
Rachel: added configs in the issue: `max_batch_delay=6ms`, `slot_reclaim_ms=1200ms`. Also attached prometheus snapshots.
Deploy-bot: Canary deployment started: canary=rdx2-small:v1234 -> shards [5,6,7], initiated by Sam :rocket:
CI-bot: Smoke tests passed for canary (basic generation, kv sanity). All green.
Sam: next steps: 1) Mike to review PR3421, 2) Olivia to repro OOM locally and confirm if a pre-allocation cap helps, 3) Rachel to run a second microbench with `slot_reclaim_ms=800ms`. If no OOMs in 30m, we'll continue ramp to remaining shards.
Olivia: I'll repro in ~30m and post logs here. If I hit OOM, I'll try `--kv-prealloc=24GiB` as a mitigation.
Mike: ack. Marking PR for review now.
Rachel: kicking off bench run with 800ms, will ping when complete.
Sam: thanks team. If anyone sees unusual p99 spikes on canary, tag `@oncall-runtime` and paste the link to the trace. Also adding a quick note to runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/priming-handshake.
Olivia: noted. Will update here in ~45m. :eyes:
